description.fun: A massive, lion-like beast with a frill of horns like a Styracosaurus, rumoured to set off magma eruptions just by roaring. Barely anyone has seen it: one short video shows it rampaging and spouting pillars of flame, and a paranormal magazine called it an Entei regenerated from a fossil. The idea may nod to the Deccan Traps, volcanic eruptions that may have helped end the dinosaurs.
description.guide: A Fire and Dragon-type Paradox Pokémon introduced in The Indigo Disk, said to be either an ancient relative of Entei or a version of it from a parallel timeline. It resembles a horned dinosaur and is believed to have powerful control over fire. Its counterpart is Iron Boulder.
description.tagline: An ancient Entei with a dinosaur's frill and a volcanic roar
